headline: Akis Skertsos: "Support for households on energy costs, based on fiscal capacity"
summary: Greek Minister of State Akis Skertsos said income support for households on energy costs will be based on fiscal capacity and that citizens' incomes will not be left unprotected.
why: Energy subsidies and household support measures affect government deficits and consumer spending, which feed into sovereign debt and retail demand.
